HackerFab

Process Core Member

Cleanroom process development & instrumentation

Standardized photoresist spin coating on diced silicon, reducing patterning failures by 70%. Fabricating MOS capacitors through thermal oxidation, photolithography, wet etching, and aluminum sputtering.

Building a low-cost laser-scanning microscope using a DVD optical pickup and piezoelectric stage.

SEP 2025 — APR 2026

Formlabs

SLS Materials Intern · Boston, MA

Polymer formulation & manufacturing scale-up

Optimized polyamide powder formulations, increasing elongation at break from less than 2% to 8%. Led a 16× scale-up of powder blending from benchtop to industrial mixers.

Contributed to high-ductility nylon powder development, increasing defect-free part yield by 25%.

FEB 2025 — APR 2025

University of Toronto

Undergraduate Research Assistant

Experimental systems & materials characterization

Designed and prototyped a motorized hydrogel grinder using 3D-printed components, reducing average particle size by 70% and processing time from over one hour to less than five minutes.

Iterated seven grinder head designs in SolidWorks, validated microscope data with ImageJ, and used quantitative NMR to study UV curing.
